description: This Java source file defines a custom media route provider for Android, demonstrating how to create a custom media route service by extending MediaRouteProvider. It includes route registration, control handling, session management, and interaction with a media player, tailored for a sample media routing implementation.

classes.name: SampleMediaRouteProvider
classes.description: A custom media route provider for Android that sets up and manages multiple media routes with different control filters and session handling.

classes.name: SampleRouteController
classes.description: Inner class extending MediaRouteProvider.RouteController, responsible for handling media control commands, managing session states, volume, and interactions with the Player.

methods.name: publishRoutes
methods.description: Constructs and publishes multiple media route descriptors with different control filters and configurations.

methods.name: onCreateRouteController
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of SampleRouteController for a given route ID.

methods.name: addDataTypeUnchecked
methods.description: Adds a MIME type to an IntentFilter, handling MalformedMimeTypeException.
